column3: MT 8:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “To the choirmaster” is rendered “To the Chief Musician,” and עַל־ הַגִּתִּית (“on the Gittith”) “On the instrument of Gath.”
Close to the Hebrew; לְהַשְׁבִּית (“to make cease”) is rendered “silence.”
NKJV renders מֵאֱלֹהִים (“than God / divine beings”) as “than the angels,” following the Septuagint interpretation.
